# Paws Out Dog Walking

> > Boutique off-leash dog walking and hiking service offering structured adventure walks, memberships, and pet transport across MetroWest Massachusetts.

Paws Out, founded by Karen Goldstein with 14+ years of experience, specializes in small-group off-leash adventure walks and trail hikes for dogs in the Natick and MetroWest area. The service combines supervised pack walks on local conservation trails with premium membership options and concierge pickup/dropoff.

## Key Topics

- Off-leash dog walking
- Trail adventures & pack walks
- Natick, MA
- MetroWest Massachusetts
- Trail membership
